lead: Gritty cinematic film still at night, concrete basement, bare yellow bulb, teal fluorescent light.
notes: Mood-only mini images for Underground Brawl.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen "Underground Brawl-mini" --model sdxl --max 999, then finish "Underground Brawl-mini" --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.prompt: A crowd gathered in a circle in an underground parking garage at night.
